name: Erwina Heidenheim
original_name: エルヴィナ ハイデンハイム
source:
A soldier of Prussia, she is one of the first generation superhumans created from the experiment called "Valkyrie Plan".

Based on Johannes Erwin Eugen Rommel, also known as the Desert Fox, who was a field marshal (senior military commander) in the Wehrmacht of Nazi Germany during World War II. He was born in Heidenheim.
